title: An old rope bridge sways across a ravine
description: The shortcut saves a day's travel, but the planks are rotten and the wind is up.

choices.text: Send the most agile across first to scout.

onPass.narration: The lead scout makes it. The party crosses with whispered footing. You save a day.

onFail.narration: A plank gives way mid-cross. You haul them up, but the party loses a day backtracking.

choices.text: Go the long way around. Safer.

onPass.narration: You take the road. Slow. Safe. No surprises.
